steps.note: The protein is unfolded by the heat, so the enzymes can reach it.

steps.name: break down
steps.note: The protein is first cut by Alcalase, an enzyme made by bacteria.

steps.name: break down
steps.note: The whey protein is broken down by trypsin, another enzyme, for a further 3 hours, so the cutting takes 6 hours in all.
The hydrolysate is dried by spraying into hot air, if it is sold as a powder.

sources.text: One worked example of hydrolysing whey protein isolate; other makers choose other enzymes, times and pH.
